- Staged uplift schedule: I inserted a placeholder exhibit (Exhibit E — Staged Capacity Schedule) and linked it to the Order Form quantities; Marcus, please populate the Q3/Q4 numbers.

- Dedicated vs Hosted: Added a paragraph defining capacity classification and an operations handoff checklist to capture migration windows and potential data segregation notes.

I've also flagged two commercial asks for Sales: (1) confirm pricing adjustments for staged uplift (flat per-seat discount vs. volume tiers) and (2) decide whether to require a 60-day notice window for switching capacity classification mid-term.
